def _execute(
    name: str,
    num_nodes: int,
    machine: Optional[Machine] = None,
    command: Optional[str] = None,
) -> None:

    if not _LIGHTNING_SDK_AVAILABLE:
        raise ModuleNotFoundError("The `lightning_sdk` module is required but not available.")

    skip_install = os.getenv("LIGHTNING_SKIP_INSTALL", "")
    branch = os.getenv("LIGHTNING_BRANCH", "")

    formatted_skip_install = f"--skip-install {skip_install}" if skip_install else ""
    formatted_branch = f"--branch {branch}" if branch else ""

    studio = Studio()

    cwd = os.getcwd()
    default_command = f"cd {cwd} && {formatted_skip_install} {formatted_branch}"
    final_command = command if command else default_command

    job = studio._studio_api.create_data_prep_machine_job(
        name=name,
        num_nodes=num_nodes,
        machine=machine,
        command=final_command,
    )

    job_url_printed = False

    while True:
        job_status = studio._studio_api.get_job_status(job.id)

        if job_status == "failed" and not job_url_printed:
            print(f"Job URL: {job.url}")
            job_url_printed = True

        if job_status in ["failed", "stopped", "completed"]:
            break

        time.sleep(5)

    if job_status == "failed":
        raise RuntimeError("The job has failed.")
